blurb: Offers guided fishing trips on Lake Taneycomo including wading and boat trips. Trips are tailored to style and skill level, including fly fishing or spin fishing. The guide has over 27 years of experience and tournament background.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before the scheduled trip to avoid a cancellation fee · Rescheduling requests must be made at least 24 hours in advance and are subject to availability · Trips may be cancelled or rescheduled due to weather conditions, safety concerns, or unforeseen circumstances
